text:
Priya: Heads-up — we need to lock the MVP vs v1 cutlist for the Q3 launch. Can we agree on criteria and a final slice by EOD tomorrow? @Evan can you flag any non-negotiable infra blockers?

Evan: I can do a pass. short summary: anything that adds a new long-lived infra component (new DB, stateful service) is high cost. Prefer postponing to v1 unless it's customer-blocking.

Maya: Agree with Evan. My suggested prioritization order: 1) Customer blocking (paying pilot) 2) End-to-end GA user flows 3) Observability/sla items 4) Nice-to-have features.

Jordan: From SRE: we need clear rollback and canary paths for any route we keep in MVP. If a feature increases RPS by >2x or needs cross-region routing, mark as "requires infra prep".

Lena: UX note: a couple of advanced settings add a lot of cognitive load. If we cut settings to a single "performance" toggle we buy a lot of polish time for v1.

Tomas: Sales signal — AcmeCorp is asking for tenant-level SSO + data residency. They can pilot without full residency if we surface a clear timeline. Recommend pilot in MVP behind a gated rollout rather than full ship.

Priya: OK — proposed quick cut matrix (engineering effort x customer impact) — small brain dump: 
```
cut_matrix:
- keep: embeddings-cache (low effort, high customer impact)
- keep: tenant-routing basics (medium effort, required for pilots)
- postpone: tenant-analytics dashboard (high effort, medium impact)
- cut: ad-hoc advanced routing rules (high effort, low GA impact)
- postpone: on-prem installer tweaks (compliance edge, v1)
```

Evan: That looks sensible. Two infra notes: (1) embeddings-cache needs memcached tuning — low risk but I'll schedule a config window. (2) tenant-routing basics relies on a DB index that we should prewarm.

Jordan: I'll add a canary plan. Suggest 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with automated rollback on error budget burn or 5xx spike.

canary-bot: deploy/checklist created: 1729000001-canary-plan (owner: Jordan) — checks: health, latency, error-rate, quota.

Maya: Quick ask: can we treat SSO as "MVP gated feature"? show a soft flag for pilots and hide for public customers until v1.

Tomas: yes, pilot gating is fine. We just need a short commitment window to share with AcmeCorp (ETA: target v1 + 6 weeks for residency discussion).

Priya: Actionable next steps: (1) Evan/Jordan/Lena finalize infra + UX minimal implementation by EOD tomorrow, (2) I will update roadmap PR with the cut matrix and gate rules, (3) Tomas to confirm pilot acceptance criteria with AcmeCorp by EOD. If all green we ship MVP slice without advanced analytics and with gated SSO.

Evan: I'll post a short checklist in the thread once infra tasks are scheduled.

Lena: Will prepare a trimmed UI mock for the single "performance" toggle by tomorrow morning.

Priya: Thanks team :raised_hands: — if nothing unexpected comes up I'll mark the cutlist and create the release ticket by 5pm PT tomorrow.

Maya: :thumbsup:
